# S-Collect Admin Dashboard

> S-Collect Admin is a management platform for e-commerce vendor operations, revenue analytics, inventory management, and financial payouts.

## Key Sections

- [Dashboard](/): Overview of revenue, sales trends, orders by status, and vendor metrics.
- [Vendors](/vendors): Comprehensive management of registered vendors and performance analytics.
- [Vouchers](/vouchers): Platform voucher codes, marketing expense tracking, and promotion management.
